description: Professional bio writer — Write a professional bio from your facts in four lengths: headline, short (~40 words), medium (~110), long (~220) and first-person (~90), plus skill tags. Uses only the facts you give; offline checks flag numbers not in your facts, buzzwords (passionate, guru, visionary...), missing name and length misses. Optional: role, tone=professional|friendly|bold|academic. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

facts.description: e.g. CFO at Acme Corp for 6 years, previously audit manager at Deloitte, CPA, MBA from UT Austin, mentors first-generation college students

name: ai_bio
